pageTitle: Byron Bay Peanut Butter Jar Line
headline: Every jar checked, not a sample.
formProduct: Peanut butter and satay sauce jars
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With smooth, crunchy and several satay sauces going into similar jars, the label and lid are what keep every jar right. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your filling line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every jar has its lid on, straight and fully seated. A loose lid means oil leaks in the carton and a jar that comes back as a complaint.
labelLede: A crunchy jar and a smooth jar, or two satay sauces, can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every jar carries the right label for what is inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: Every jar needs a correct, readable best-before date and batch code. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Lid offcuts, label backing and loose parts can end up near the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before jars reach a carton.

vocab.alert: Four crooked lids in fifteen minutes. Check the capper.
